session_summary: As a first-time player, I successfully traversed the Moss Trail route from step 0 to step 12. Along the way, I engaged and defeated three enemies (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) and completed the route, earning 25 coins and finishing with 149 total coins and full 100 HP. The session was straightforward, but entirely lacked introductory onboarding prompts or guidance at step 0.

observations.evidence: Starting the session on Moss Trail at step 0 immediately transitions to walking actions with no introductory tooltips, tutorial screens, or instruction on controls.
observations.recommendation: Implement onboarding welcome tooltips at step 0 to clearly explain movement and combat mechanics to first-time players.

observations.evidence: The route selection and journey provided little contextual narrative or clarity regarding why Moss Trail was chosen or what to expect next.
observations.recommendation: Add descriptive route preview highlights when selecting a path for the first time.

feature_requests.title: Initial Onboarding Tutorial Tooltips
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players instantly understand how to move and fight without confusion.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a new player is dropped straight into the walk sequence with zero context or instruction.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: First-time players see clear, non-intrusive instructional text prompts during their initial steps on Moss Trail.

keep: Smooth progression from start to finish on the Moss Trail route without crashes or dead ends.
Clear telemetry tracking of enemy encounters and route completion rewards.
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
